# ArduPilot ParameterRepository (Rover)

## Origin

    https://github.com/ArduPilot/ParameterRepository
    commit 19f34fc6eba8abeac2dc14a96e9819ca4388a555, folders Rover-4.0 … Rover-4.8, file apm.pdef.json

`apm.pdef.json` is generated by ArduPilot from the `@DisplayName`, `@Description`, `@Units`,
`@Range`, `@Increment`, `@Values`, `@Bitmask`, `@RebootRequired` and `@ReadOnly` comments in the
ArduPilot firmware sources, one file per vehicle and release. The repository has no Rover-4.3
folder.

`rover.json` is derived from those files by `scripts/update_ardupilot_params.py`; it is not edited
by hand. It keeps only the fields listed above, renamed (`name`, `desc`, `units`, `range`, `inc`,
`values`, `bits`, `reboot`, `readOnly`), and stores each distinct description of a parameter once,
with `v` listing the releases it applies to. The header records the source commit and the release
list.

## Use

Bundled into the app as `:/autopilot/rover.params.json`. The autopilot parameters window picks the
release whose `major.minor` is the closest one not newer than the vehicle's AUTOPILOT_VERSION, or
the oldest one when the vehicle is older than all of them, or the newest one when the vehicle
reports no version. Only ArduPilot (`MAV_AUTOPILOT` 3) with
`MAV_TYPE` ground rover (10) or surface boat (11) uses it.

## Updating

```bash
python scripts/update_ardupilot_params.py
```

Downloads the current `main` of the repository and rewrites `rover.json` and nothing else; update
the commit above and, when the release range changes, the version in `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md` and
on the About page (`qml/app/AboutPage.qml`). `python scripts/update_ardupilot_params.py check`
exits 1 when the committed file differs from what the current upstream would produce.
